author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Olimex recently featured the WCH CH32V006EVT, a low-cost evaluation board for the RISC-V-based CH32V006K8U6 microcontroller. The board is designed around WCH’s CH32V006 family and provides a compact platform for experimenting with the QingKe V2C 32-bit RISC-V core, Zephyr support, and basic embedded development features. The CH32V006K8U6 integrates a QingKe V2C processor using the RV32EmC instruction […]
title: WCH CH32V006EVT board supports Zephyr for low-cost RISC-V development
